approval_user_text: Réutilise les coordonnées déjà utilisées pour les transports publics et calcule les temps routiers entre ces mêmes points. Ne bloque plus la collecte sur la recherche des mairies et parkings : garde ces précisions comme raffinement ultérieur.
coordinate_rule: Keep selected_stop_id from existing TP nodes; resolve its unique official BAV operating-point E,N, EPSG:2056 to WGS84 with always_xy. No resort reference point, town hall, parking, GTFS platform average or new stop selection.
territory_rule: Retain 185 territories /186 source histories, approved Moutier 700/6831 bridge only when their original selected stops coincide. Retain 75 access IDs in71 unchanged station groups.
metric: Independent static fastest modelled driving directions, seconds/60 then (outbound+return)/2 if both usable; no traffic or winter supplements; no final walk invented.
snapping: Keep service-reported snapped_distance and resolved location in both directions, plus independently computed geodesic displacement. List missing/null/zero, endpoint inconsistencies and largest displacements. No arbitrary acceptance threshold or automatic exclusion.
missing_route: Missing directions remain missing, not zero. User approved three stop→same-stop pairs at0min for this proxy only. Distinct points collapsed by snapping, including Saas-Fee, remain unvalidated; no true lift-departure coincidence inferred.
identical_stop_zero_approval_user_text: Oui, valider les trois vrais trajets arrêt → même arrêt à 0 minute.
winter_limit: Current static graph, no route geometry in Matrix response; seasonal restrictions/legal car access not certified. Large snaps and car-free places require later review, not automatic exclusion.
administrative_parking_refinement: Prior documented endpoint inventory and first three municipality-parking means preserved separately; further research deferred by user.
public_transport_comparison: Common selected TP stop IDs and official stop point geometry, not exact surveyed station parking or platform; retain source date mismatch (OFT2026-09-20, GTFS2026-02-07). Comparability is stop-to-stop, not door-to-door.
